dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple high-contrast circular and semi-circular light-toned structures are visible along the mid-to-posterior dorsal-lateral axis. The geometry features irregular, jittered perimeters where dark background pixels transition sharply to light interiors, notably in a centralized 'O' shape and several posterior 'C' shaped structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of saturated, low-gradient white pixel clusters is localized on the anterior-ventral and mid-ventral flank. These clusters form irregular, solid-toned regions that lack the internal dark-to-light gradient seen in the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship observed between the centroid of the primary central 'O' annulus, the centroid of the posterior 'C' cluster, and the leading superior edge of the large ventral high-intensity blob, forming a triangular spatial configuration.

other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency micro-speckling pattern localized on the muzzle and orbital regions, distinct in scale from the larger dorsal-lateral macro-annuli.
